risk_assessment: MEDIUM. The change introduces real multithreaded execution but only inside an already-pure A5 preparation phase. The high-risk canonical boundaries are deliberately unchanged: all worker tasks join before one global Field.allocate_demands(), and post-allocation lifecycle advance remains serial. Deep copies isolate worker inputs and deterministic workset-order consumption prevents completion timing from affecting demand order. Windows exact execution proves the threaded path and all closed ecology regressions on the exact subject. Remaining platform risk is Linux-specific thread/runtime behavior, explicitly reserved for Independent Verifier evidence before acceptance.
